title: Rust SCHC failure tracker never reclaims churned signer slots
description: RuleVersionFailureTracker fixed slots are cleared only by success from the same signer; link peer retirement/eviction is not wired to tracker retirement or bounded replacement. After MAX_SOURCES one-failure signers churn out, all later failing signers return FailureTrackerFull and lose parsing errors/notifications indefinitely. Add explicit retirement/current-peer-aware bounded eviction without evicting active failure runs, and preserve the original parse error while signaling capacity.
